added_models.model: SCID mice bearing CD20+ human B-cell tumour xenografts dosed with ofatumumab (tumour growth vs plasma concentration)

dose.note: Xenograft: initial plasma 5 ug/mL, expected to saturate CD20, inhibited tumour; regrowth below half-saturation; 5-10 ug/mL proposed for sustained activity.
dose.quote: In a mouse xenograft model, a single dose, resulting in an initial plasma antibody concentration of 5 microg/ml, which was expected to result in full target saturation, effectively inhibited human B-cell tumour development.
dose.judgement: The exposure target (plasma 5-10 ug/mL maintaining CD20 saturation) is stated by the xenograft/monkey paper itself, so it is this track's dose prediction; no tolerability margin stated.

dose.note: WM patients on 1000-2000 mg had troughs of 23-181 ug/mL before dose 4, well above the xenograft's 5-10 ug/mL saturation target.
dose.quote: C trough prior to Dose 4, μg/mL 13 23·4 (5,252) 21 181 (252)
dose.confidence_note: PMC full text (PMC5484580) Table 5 read; quote is a table row. Ctrough first posted with registry results 2012-04-30 (NCT00811733); paper online Dec 2016.
dose.judgement: Judgement call: paired by me; the WM trial does not cite the xenograft target. Early troughs before dose 2 (3.0 and 8.0 ug/mL) sat near or below it, but from dose 3 on troughs exceeded it in both groups, so same.
dose.magnitude_basis: plasma ofatumumab trough vs 5-10 ug/mL saturation target

efficacy.note: A single ofatumumab dose inhibited human B-cell tumour development in SCID mice; FDA cites the xenograft as proof of concept.
efficacy.quote: In a mouse xenograft model, a single dose, resulting in an initial plasma antibody concentration of 5 microg/ml, which was expected to result in full target saturation, effectively inhibited human B-cell tumour development.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Europe PMC). The xenograft cell line is not named in the abstract; no WM-derived cells were used.
efficacy.judgement: Kept separate from the draft's in-vitro CDC/ADCC track: an in-vivo animal system with its own readout.

efficacy.note: Phase 2 NCT00811733: ofatumumab monotherapy gave 51-59% overall response in untreated or relapsed WM.
efficacy.quote: 19 (51%, 95% CI 34·4-68·1) of 37 patients achieved an overall response after cycle 1 and 22 (59%, 42·1-75·2) of 37 achieved an overall response after the redosing cycle
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract plus PMC full text. Year set by registry results posting 2012-04-30; paper online Dec 2016.
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: class-level direction only (tumour inhibition vs response); paired by me, the trial paper cites in-vitro CDC, not the xenograft.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: overall response rate vs xenograft tumour inhibition

patient_trials.quote: Overall Response Rate (CR + PR + MR) of Ofatumumab in Combination With Bortezomib

considered_not_added: Ofatumumab population PK / TMDD model (FDA ClinPharmR, Furman 2017 NONMEM): descriptive, fitted after dosing; the 2000 mg dose came from CLL exposure-response in patients, not a model prediction
FCGR3A V158F genotype as a patient-level predictor: studied for rituximab (not a member) in WM; no ofatumumab, ublituximab or veltuzumab WM genotype-response study found
CD20 expression level on WM cells: Furman cites low CD20 in WM as a reason to raise the dose but reports no CD20-response correlation; no patient comparison
Ublituximab cynomolgus and in-vitro ADCC models (FDA 761238, MS): no ublituximab WM patient data, so nothing to compare; the WM ex-vivo NK ADCC track is already in the draft
Veltuzumab SCID/Raji xenograft and cynomolgus data: veltuzumab has no WM patient data (NCT00989586 is a B-NHL combination)
NCT01536067 (ofatumumab + bortezomib, untreated WM): a combination patient trial, not a model system; belongs in patient_trials on the existing efficacy track
Human challenge, genetic, patient-derived organoid/PDX co-clinical or QSP dose models for member drugs in WM: none found
